name: Alto DUSD
oneLiner: DUSD is Alto's overcollateralized USD stablecoin minted from isolated on-chain markets backed by ETH, BTC, and yield-bearing variants, with a capped USDC PSM.
collateral: On-chain collateral and fixed-price issuance routes on Ethereum. The current issuer snapshot lists active mint markets for frxUSD, wstETH, WETH, rETH, sUSDe and syrupUSDC. Historical isolated borrow/mint markets and USDC/frxUSD peg-stability routes remain distinct mechanisms; current limits and fees require contract review.
pegMechanism: Collateralized mint markets create new DUSD; borrow markets redistribute existing DUSD. The documented public USDC PSM quotes 1:1 before a 0.20% fee in either direction and a 5M-USDC exposure cap, with redemption limited by actual USDC inventory. An Owner Multisig controls parameter changes through a timelock; a separate emergency multisig can freeze swaps.
